units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 8:6:2">Y. Keth. VIII, 32ᵇ</cite> top <he>כדי טְפִילָתָן</he> as much as their sustenance costs.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:1:10">Y. Orl. I, 60ᵈ</cite> top <he>כדי טְפִילָתָהּ</he> worth the labor given to its (the grape-vine’s) cultivation (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 1:2">Orl. I, 2</cite> <he>נפילתה</he>).
